mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the fact lets a successful operation occur without the (role, kind) being licensed by PermMatrix.Allowed. The injection forces a customer to successfully POST a decision, which LeastPrivilege and FR_015 forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = PostDecision and some op.presented and op.presented.role = Customer and op.outcome = OkSuccess }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the fact lets two events share the same (application, eventType) pair — the structural signature of an UPDATE/replace masquerading as an append. The injection forces such a duplicate to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj e1, e2: ApplicationEvent | e1.application = e2.application and e1.eventType = e2.eventType }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without this fact, a decided application can exist with no corresponding decision event. The injection produces an Approved application that has zero approved events.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some a: LoanApplication | a.status = ApprovedS and (no e: ApplicationEvent | e.application = a and e.eventType = EvtApproved) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the fact lets a customer who probes another customer's reference receive PermissionDenied — a side channel revealing that the resource exists. The injection forces precisely that leaky outcome.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoLeakageViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = GetApplicationByRef and some op.presented and op.presented.role = Customer and some op.target and op.target.customer != op.presented and op.outcome = OkPermissionDenied }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without this fact, a single customer can hold multiple in-flight applications. The injection forces two distinct Pending Review applications to share one customer.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OnePendingViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.customer = a2.customer and a1.status = PendingReview and a2.status = PendingReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without this fact, two staff members can both have their decisions recorded against the same application (the SC-005 race). The injection forces two distinct decisions for one application.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoDecisionsViolation { some disj d1, d2: Decision | d1.application = d2.application }
